text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Hmm...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, I find Ines Fujin standing in
front of a
pile of Toughness bars with a
concerned look on
her face.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Okay, listen to this. I was at one of my
part-time
jobs yesterday...

text_block_list.name: Shift Supervisor
text_block_list.text:
A while back, one of our clients gave us
a whole
load of Toughness bars to
sample.

text_block_list.name: Shift Supervisor
text_block_list.text:
But I shoved all of them wayyy to the
back of the
storeroom, and forgot to eat
any.

text_block_list.name: Shift Supervisor
text_block_list.text:
Looks like they're going to expire
tomorrow, but
you can take as many as
you'd like.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...So anyway, that's what happened! It's
nice that I
got to bring these back, but
there are waaay too
many!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I already tried to share them with friends
and
stuff, but I couldn't really hand
them out in bulk
when they're about to
expire, you know?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Just look at them all! What am I
supposed to do
with them? It'd be a
waste to throw this much
food away.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
But eating them all would definitely
mess with my
diet... Right?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Sigh... What should I dooo? This is hopeless! I'm no good at this stuff!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...Ahaha. Yeah, I figured.
choice_data_list: もう、一気に食べてしまおう！

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I figured that was our only option too!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I was just getting hungry anyhow. Plus,
I'm about
to go do some training!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
And even if this does mess up my calorie
count, it
won't just be my fault! You're
my accomplice!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! You're going to eat them too?!
You do
realize this is a lot of Toughness
bars, right?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I'm an Umamusume, so that's one thing,
but... are
you really gonna be able to eat
half of these?
Won't you get
stomachache?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...Well, if you're sure. Okay then, thanks
for the
help!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: But... how about we start you off with a third of the bars? No, wait, just a quarter of them! That'd be a huge help!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha. Yeah, you're right. There's no
way I could
eat this many...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
It's a bit of a waste, but I guess these
things
happen!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
All right, I'm going to go throw these
bars away
before I change my mind!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: B-before I change my mind!
